raw_segments.text: Father Conme began to walk along the North Strand Road and was saluted by Mr. William
Gallagher who stood in the doorway of his shop.
Father Conme saluted Mr. William Gallagher and perceived the odors that came from bacon
flitches and ample cools of butter.
